items.description: Thousands are still missing as Chinese state media report the official number of fatalities in Tibet at 16.

items.description: Unconfirmed local reports say the Israeli military carried out air and artillery strikes after a raid by an Israel-backed militia was discovered.

items.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted over the drive-by shooting of the rap superstar 30 years ago.

items.title: Teen girl charged with murder over recording of San Diego mosque attack
items.description: Prosecutors say the 17-year-old from North Carolina also published a manifesto from the two teenage shooters in the 18 May attack.

items.title: Shein valued at $26bn after long-awaited stock market debut
items.description: The firm's Hong Kong listing on Tuesday comes after a years-long quest to sell shares in New York and London.

items.title: South Korean police officer admits to closing missing person cases to avoid work
items.description: The officer falsely claimed he contacted missing persons and prematurely closed their cases on the South Korean holiday island of Jeju.

items.title: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
items.description: Amazon responded to the lawsuit, arguing the US Federal Trade Commission "misunderstands" their ad market.

items.title: Zambia's president sworn in for second term while opponent detained
items.description: Hakainde Hichilema swept to victory, but his main rival is now in custody charged with treason.

items.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
items.description: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.
